narratives.Overview:
1. **Refuse unmarked admit for proposed/historical cites (primary).** In `deriveUnmarkedFinalizeAdmit` / owed discovery: when the tip brief is `proposed` (tip folder and/or `plan.status == proposed`, and maybe `draft`) and the only merged `github-pr` / `prRefs` evidence is historical context without `plan.metadata.productPullRequest`, do **not** admit as owed/blocks. Keep true unmarked `active`/`pending` Tracking leftovers with merged product evidence + open non-protected origin blocking.

2. **Align protected skip with finalize-cohort staying-open.** Compose or share existing `PROTECTED_STAYING_OPEN_LABELS` / `isProtectedStayingOpenUmbrella` (`epic`, `meta`, `tracker`, `type:tracker`, `status:tracker`, `umbrella`, `type:umbrella`, plus umbrella substring) for owed discovery skip instead of the narrower `protectedUmbrella` predicate in `finalize-owed.ts` `fetchIssueState`. Do not invent a second label vocabulary. Pair with item 1 rather than treating epic/tracker widen as a substitute for the proposed unmarked refuse.

3. **Regression test.** Fixture matching the #635/#401 shape (tip proposed brief citing merged PR + open epic/`status:tracker` origin, no `metadata.productPullRequest`) must report zero blocking owed stories; session-start must not block solely on that shape without `--defer-owed`. True unmarked Tracking leftovers still block.

4. **Non-goals.** Tip hygiene for April #635 proposed briefs (#5142 / PR #5144). Ceremony cost under `--defer-owed` (#5145). Changing leftover-complete semantics for true Tracking orphans.

## Unmarked compose is not a durable delivery mark
sharpens-framing
Evidence: At `1890550a2afa`, `productPullRequestFromPlan` (`packages/core/src/orphan-active/running-briefs.ts`) reads only `plan.metadata.productPullRequest`. `discoverFinalizeOwed` uses that mark first; only when null does it call `deriveUnmarkedFinalizeAdmit` (`orphan-active/evaluate.ts`), which admits on any same-repo confirmed-merged `prRefs` github-pr plus same-repo origin issue, with no `plan.status` check and no proposed/draft refuse. Unmarked unit coverage in `finalize-cohort.test.ts` uses `status: "running"` and `xbrief/active/` stuck-brief fixtures (#3791 P3). `TIP_NONTERMINAL_FOLDERS` still includes `proposed`, and `finalize-owed.ts` never reads `plan.status`.
Failure mode: Binding the target as true collapses historical `x-xbrief/github-pr` provenance on tip `proposed/` into full-story delivery debt. Session-start then blocks mutation on lifecycle paper that #4919/#3791 unmarked compose was not written to own.
Disposition: Bound remedy must treat proposed (tip-folder and/or status) unmarked github-pr cites without `metadata.productPullRequest` as non-admit for owed/blocks. Keep true unmarked `active`/`pending` Tracking leftovers with merged product evidence + open non-protected origin blocking.

## Protected skip already exists wider on finalize-cohort
sharpens-framing
Evidence: `finalize-cohort.ts` `PROTECTED_STAYING_OPEN_LABELS` is the closed set `epic`, `meta`, `tracker`, `type:tracker`, `status:tracker`, `umbrella`, `type:umbrella`, plus `lower.includes("umbrella")`, used by `isProtectedStayingOpenUmbrella` to skip origin-close. `finalize-owed.ts` `fetchIssueState` sets `protectedUmbrella` only when `lower.includes("umbrella")` or `lower === "status:protected"` or `lower === "protected"` — no epic/tracker. After unmarked admit + snapshot accept + no twin, open non-`protectedUmbrella` origins become `state: "owed"` with `blocks: true`, which `evaluateFinalizeOwedSessionGate` turns into mutation block unless `--defer-owed`.
Failure mode: Preferring a brand-new protected-tracker allowlist (or leaving owed discovery on the narrow predicate) drifts from the cohort staying-open set and leaves the #635 epic+`status:tracker` shape permanently blocking while cohort already knows those origins stay open by design.
Disposition: Compose or share the existing `PROTECTED_STAYING_OPEN_LABELS` / `isProtectedStayingOpenUmbrella` predicate for owed discovery skip. Do not invent a second label vocabulary. Epic/tracker widen alone is still incomplete for proposed+historical-pr under ordinary open story origins; pair it with the proposed unmarked refuse above rather than OR-equating the two levers.

## Tip hygiene and defer cost stay adjacent
footnote
Evidence: Operator note 5893989679 and Stop 1 / current-state name tip hygiene #5142 / PR #5144 and ceremony cost #5145 as out of this first-ship. Inventory confirms those are separate surfaces from the unmarked-admit / protected-skip predicates above.
Failure mode: None for binding this gate fix if those stay non-goals.
Disposition: Keep them out of first-ship; no change required for this refutation.

metadata.issueBody:
## Summary

`discoverFinalizeOwed` / session-start finalize-owed treats tip nonterminal briefs that historically cite a merged trim PR as owed leftover, even when those briefs were deferred follow-ons that later shipped under different PRs (or were abandoned).

Concrete false-positive shape (April #635 / PR #401 arc):
- Tip `xbrief/proposed/*635*` briefs still reference merged PR #401 via `x-xbrief/github-pr`
- Unmarked compose (`deriveUnmarkedFinalizeAdmit`) admits them as `productPr=#401` with origin `#635`
- `#635` is open with labels `epic` + `status:tracker`, but `protectedUmbrella` only matches labels containing `umbrella` / `protected`
- Session-start therefore blocks: `#635 owed [blocks] pr=#401`

Product for those children already landed (#705 rule-ownership, #707/#706 events). The tip proposed copies were leftover lifecycle debt, not unfinished delivery of #401.

## Bound remedy (recommended)

1. Widen finalize-owed protected skip to include `epic` and/or `status:tracker` (same skip path as umbrella/protected), **or** an explicit protected-tracker allowlist.
2. Refuse unmarked admit for `plan.status == proposed` (and maybe `draft`) when the only merged `github-pr` ref is historical context without `metadata.productPullRequest`.
3. Regression test: proposed tip brief citing merged PR + open epic/tracker origin must **not** enter owed/blocks inventory.

## Out of scope

- Tip hygiene for the four April #635 proposed briefs (separate chore; clears inventory without waiting on this gate fix).
- Changing leftover-complete semantics for true Tracking orphans.

## Acceptance

- `discoverFinalizeOwed` dry-run against a fixture matching the #635/#401 shape reports zero blocking owed stories for that brief.
- Session-start no longer blocks solely on that shape (without `--defer-owed`).
- True unmarked Tracking leftovers (active/pending with merged product PR + open origin) still block.

Refs #4919 #635 #642 #401
